verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-operation feature in the evidence. Bulk work is only implied: agents and scripts can run non-interactive SQL via `pscale sql`, which can touch many rows in one statement. The CLI and API can create, delete and list databases and branches programmatically, so multi-item operations are possible only by scripting. Missing for 10: explicit batch or bulk operations across many databases, branches or resources in one command or API call, documentation of bulk semantics (e.g., partial-failure handling), and hands-on corroboration of agents doing bulk work.
